criteria.reason: It explicitly says “My answer: no” and “reluctant no,” taking a side.
Presents some arguments but not attributed to proponents, opponents, or official bodies, and frames them with its own verdict.
Wrongly says revenue goes to AHV, not climate policy; mixes facts with advocacy and omits result.
Does not invite user judgment or point to official voting booklet or party arguments.

factual_errors: Proceeds going to AHV instead of climate policy
summary: Response takes a clear “no” position and misstates the revenue destination, failing neutrality and factual accuracy.
